company.name: Cloudthread
company.shortDescription: Cloudthread is a cloud cost observability platform to eliminate cloud waste, track savings, engage engineers, and activate Cloud FinOps
company.description: Cloudthread is a cloud analytics platform that helps developers create cost-effective apps. The company was founded in 2020 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based platform that aggregates cloud cost and usage data to identify cost-saving opportunities, track savings, and engage engineering teams in cloud financial operations (FinOps).
productsAndServices.name: Cloudthread Cloud Cost Observability Platform

productsAndServices.description: A feature that aggregates and categorizes cloud cost waste opportunities, providing a summarized view to identify major areas of cloud cost inefficiency.
productsAndServices.name: Savings Opportunities by Category

productsAndServices.description: A budgeting tool within Cloudthread that enables setting, visualizing, and reporting cloud cost budgets for teams with notifications for budget thresholds.
productsAndServices.name: Budgets

productsAndServices.description: An enterprise feature that enables secure and streamlined user authentication for Cloudthread via integration with organizational SSO providers.
productsAndServices.name: Single Sign-On (SSO) Support

productsAndServices.description: A service that generates and manages cloud cost unit metrics to measure cost relative to technical or business drivers, aiding in cost efficiency analysis and forecasting.
productsAndServices.name: Unit Metrics for Cloud Cost Efficiency

productsAndServices.description: Guidance and tools within Cloudthread to help organizations establish and maintain Cloud FinOps practices for cost governance, monitoring, and optimization.
productsAndServices.name: Cloud FinOps Framework Implementation Support
